title: smallRNA_analysis

Processing
Before the analysis, we did a few processing and filtering steps to remove non-relevant components such as adaptors, rRNA, tRNA, reads in low complexity regions,etc.

title: smallRNA_analysis
text:
Analysis
There are two main analysis I did:

Identify the mobile sRNA, i.e. smallRNA present in scion tissue (Sauvignon Blanc leaf) that presumed to be originated from the rootstock. To do this, we first align the reads to the scion genome, take the unmapped reads and align to the respective rootstock genome.
Identify smallRNA reads/clusters that are associated with drought stress. For this, we map the reads to a concatenated reference genome of the scion and rootstock, perform clustering (both done within ShortStack) and run differential analysis on the result to identify clusters that are significantly associated with drought stress
